title: Toggle-mode NAND flash target: SDR command / address cycles, DDR data in (dqs) and out (re_n echoed on dqs), Read ID, page read / program, block erase, Read Status, reset, a protected block, and protocol-error detection

fields.desc: ready (1) / busy (0); same as the rb_n pin

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: unknown command, command out of sequence, address cycle outside an address phase, or a command other than 70h / FFh while busy. Held in the core until FFh, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: ce_n, cle, ale, we_n, re_n (in), dq[7:0] and dqs (bidirectional tri-state) and rb_n (out) are the NAND bus; they pass through unchanged. PCLK oversamples the bus: each strobe phase must last at least two PCLK clocks.
The 16 x 64-byte array is reached over the NAND bus only; the registers report the ready / busy state and protocol errors.
